title: Published `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` still states the patch-only `undoable` capture set, and contradicts itself four lines later
body:
Path: none | 已发布面说错一句(北极星「优先级」4) | `undoable` 的捕获集在同一条 CHANGELOG 条目里前后矛盾,且已随 17.4.0 发布
分诊重测与定级:2026-09-20T15:25Z

## What was measured

`packages/spec` is published (`private` unset, `17.4.0`) and its `files[]` ships `CHANGELOG.md`. Read first-hand by this seat at `origin/main` = `adf4b18777d507236cd24b7ed59b45a7c71bd1fd`, 2026-09-20T10:31Z:

`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`, inside the single entry for `effae80: feat(spec): a row action gets the declarative single-record field write` (#14092):

```
:3918  - The action's existing `params`, `visible`, `confirmText` and `undoable` keys are reused,
         nothing duplicated; `undoable` now has its anchor — the patch names exactly the fields
         whose prior values are captured.

:3922  … `undoable` captures the prior values of exactly the fields written.
```

The same changelog entry states both sets, four lines apart. This is the same contradiction card #19148 found in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (`:1116` written set vs `:1313` patch-only); PR #19283 settled the source file on the **written set** and corrected the describe text and the three generated reference pages, but a code PR may not edit `content/docs/releases/` or a release-owned changelog, so this copy survives at head.

## Why it is a card and not a fix in #19283

Review checklist: 「本轮令其变假或触碰的已发布缺陷必修;只注意到、未触碰的立卡不修,记明已发布面」. #19283 did not touch this file. The published surface is named above: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`, shipped by `files[]`.

For the record, #19283's PR body says the old sentence is "all corrected or regenerated here". That is overstated by this one line — noted so nobody reads it as a clean sweep. The PR is otherwise correct and the at-tier review PASSed it (comment 5749186061).

## Direction is not settled here

A changelog is a historical record of what a release shipped, so "correct the line" and "leave it, it is history" are both defensible, and the entry's own `:3922` already carries the accurate sentence. This seat chooses neither. What is measured is only that a published file states a promise the contract no longer makes, and that it contradicts itself in place.

## Dedup words

`CHANGELOG`, `undoable`, `prior values are captured`, `effae80`, `release-owned prose`
